identity.name: Multiple Discovery Commands on Windows Host by Same Process
identity.summary: An attacker executes multiple discovery commands (whoami, net user, ipconfig) from a single process to gather system information. Cortex detects this behavior as suspicious process activity.
identity.description: An attacker executes multiple discovery commands (whoami, net user, ipconfig) from a single process to gather system information. Cortex detects this behavior as suspicious process activity.

payload.code:
C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe /c whoami
C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe /c net user
C:\Windows\System32\cmd.exe /c ipconfig /all

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Multiple Discovery Commands by Process
biocs.description: Detection of multiple discovery commands executed by the same process
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name in ('cmd.exe', 'whoami.exe', 'net.exe', 'ipconfig.exe')
| comp count() as cnt by actor_process_image_name
| comp count() as cmd_count
| filter cmd_count > 3
